test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Strength training is useful as it avoids large increases in breathing rate and ______ muscle strength.
solution: The correct answer is: "**improves**." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The blank in the sentence is asking for a word that fits with avoids large increases in breathing rate and is related to muscle strength. • Given this context, the word "**improves**" is the best fit for the blank because it means that strength training has a positive impact on muscle strength, which aligns with the intended meaning of the sentence. • The word "improves" means to make something better or enhance its quality or condition. (किसी चीज़ को बेहतर बनाना या उसकी गुणवत्ता या स्थिति को बढ़ाना) • Grammatically, "improves" is a verb that agrees with the subject "strength training." • So, the sentence would read: "*Strength training is useful as it avoids large increases in breathing rate and improves muscle strength.*" Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Regresses **means to move backwards or decline. (पीछे की ओर जाना या गिरना) • **Distributes **means to spread out or allocate. (फैलाना या आवंटित करना) • **Degrades **mean to break down or deteriorate. (टूटना या ख़राब होना) 1d9:T99f, The correct answer is: **blow**
